findings.passage: Asked by [Numéro](https://numero.com/en/culture-en/music/interview-with-olivia-dean-the-new-bewitching-voice-of-soul/) in 2025 what she would have done without music, she named a florist among other jobs.
findings.problem: Numéro did not ask this. The question was "What images come to mind when you create new songs?" She volunteered "if I hadn't been a musician, I would have wanted to be an English teacher, a dog sitter, or a florist", and Numéro followed up with "A florist?" (S13, fetched 2026-10-23). It is the same framing error verify-04 fixed for the Numéro fear line.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence presents the florist answer as volunteered, e.g. "She told Numéro in 2025, in passing, that without music she might have been an English teacher, a dog sitter or a florist". C45b's claim no longer says "Asked what she would do without music".

findings.passage: she blurs her covers so listeners can see themselves in the music. A Four tends to guard what sets her apart; Dean keeps handing it over.
findings.problem: The listener-handoff purpose comes from Music Week's question about The Art of Loving cover and RS UK's 2025 answer, but here it is applied to both covers. In Numéro (S13, translated, 2025), which the article cites elsewhere, she explained the first album's cover differently: "My music speaks… about me. My identity and my personal stories remain the common thread running through that first record ... a photo of me at 23 felt right. Nothing abstract. Also, I think I just really liked that photo of me." The omitted answer weakens a Four discriminator and the covers support for "hands over the hearing".
findings.acceptance_test: Either the cover reading is limited to her 2025 explanations of The Art of Loving and the shared blur (RS UK, Music Week), or the article notes, marked as translated, that she described the first cover as being about her own identity. C61 and C43 record the limit.

research_tasks: Why the hold. Every printed quotation and fact verified against freshly fetched pages and re-downloaded captions, with key YouTube spans re-transcribed (whisper medium.en) and the Lowe speaker confirmed on video. All 52 resolution decisions and 17 protected passages check out. The hold is the type argument: the Two-over-Three lean rests on two self-reported purpose answers (RS UK 2025, ELLE 2026) that the article itself says a Three could give, and no costly or image-versus-relationship choice separates them. More editing cannot raise the Enneagram score without overclaiming. Only new evidence can.

Transcribe S37, And The Writer Is... Ep. 226 (YouTube yzWbab28z38, 1:26:40, 2025-10-27), via audio and whisper. On 2026-10-23, yt-dlp with --extractor-args "youtube:player_client=mweb" -f 18 downloaded YouTube media where the default client returned 403. Read it for (a) any dated choice where keeping a person, collaborator or audience cost her image, money or standing, or the reverse; (b) what she says the work is for; (c) any conflict, over-giving, difficulty receiving or resentment.

Look for a documented costly choice that separates Two from Three. Candidates: whether her loyalty to Braham, Hales/Nahome and the same band (S04, S11, S22) cost her commercial options she is on record declining; whether she turned down a feature, collaboration, brand or US-writing route for a relationship's sake; whether the 2026 Grammy speech's immigration turn drew documented career risk. Use dated, opened sources only.

Seek testimony outside the friendly circle: family (her mother Christine Dean, her aunt), former collaborators, a critical profile. Also find the WSJ. Magazine print profile and the Evening Standard 2024 interview (existing follow-ups). The current record has no family, ex-partner or critic voice (C16c).

Run the settle signal (C64) when it fires: her first long post-tour interview after 17 Oct 2026, the third-album announcement, or the February 2027 Grammys season. Classify what she says she wants against people/giving (2), goals/standing (3), freedom (7) and peace (9), with the 2025 baseline in C64b.

In the same refresh, fix verify-r-01 to verify-r-04 (minor wording and record fixes). Re-run with --refresh --expanded-review if the type thesis or discriminator changes. Open-case conversion is not an obvious route: she has released music since 2018 and has a substantial 2023-2026 long-form interview record, so this looks like a hard type on a promotional record rather than a young record. Any open-case attempt needs an independent eligibility check.

enneagram.reason: The rival-testing is excellent. Three gets its best evidence (goal list, "five times better" in context, image craft, instrumental goodness). Four, Seven, Six and Nine each get sourced evidence and a sourced discriminator. No wing or arrow escape, and "Two growth" is refused by name. But the standard's 8 needs repeated costly choices the motive explains, and the strongest alternative failing a specific discriminator. Here the article concedes every outward act is low-cost or conventional. The image-versus-relationship test is "never staged". The lean rests on two self-reported purpose answers from album-campaign interviews that, by its own FAQ, "A Three could say the same". The strongest counterevidence (approval independence, "no worries if not", control of her work) is left as an unresolved strain on Two. An honest medium-confidence read, but the motive does not yet beat Three.
enneagram.passage: A Three can talk about service, and a Two can want a headline slot. The record leans Two because those answers recur, to Rolling Stone UK in 2025 and to ELLE in 2026, while the goals sound like the job.

The cited passage turns her own word choice into a reading the profile labels as its own. Reusable type boilerplate is confined to the Two definition and the three-centres gloss (lines 190-192).
